title: Service ON gives access to the Service configuration pages
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role with Settings ON and the Service sub-toggle ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Open the Settings area and look for the Service pages.
custom_expected: The Service pages are available: Canned Lines, Inspection Templates, Labour Types and Vehicle Types.
evidence: UI (role settingsService): the SERVICE group is present — Labor Rates, Canned Lines, Asset Types, Inspection Templates. screenshot settings-SetX.
